title: The Land of Light in Its Perfect Order, and the Stillness of Eternity
description: Two paired contemplations of the celestial state. The Land of Light is the Father in his outermost expression: living ambrosia and living drug, beautiful members of one body, summoned forth from the Father and established in him, with neither falsehood, nor death, nor mingling. Eternity (Aneze) and Stillness (Karetḥ) name the unchanging mode of this celestial ground — the Land of Light "before eternity unto eternity" against the Land of Death whose end is fixed within itself, the inmost that cannot be discursively uttered.
